title: OperAItor: An Agentic Framework for Fault-Tolerant Operation of Chemical Processes
title_zh: OperAItor：用于化工过程容错运行的智能体框架

paragraphs.en: 开源化工过程故障管理智能体框架，验证配置显著减少工厂停车并挽回经济损失。 OperAItor, an open-source framework for developing and evaluating large language model agents for supervisory fault management in chemical processes. The framework is demonstrated on a dynamic reactor-distillation process representing isopropanol dehydrogenation, with physically based thermodynamics and modified reaction kinetics to permit liquid-phase operation. The process is represented by a 113-variable differential-algebraic model and operates at a nominal feed rate of 100kmol/h, producing approximately 4t/h of acetone. The simulated plant includes 8 PI control loops, 22 process alarms, 5 duty-standby pump trains, and 11 independent safety instrumented functions. The agent architecture integrates multivariate statistical process monitoring, fault diagnosis, knowledge-graph retrieval, action planning, and supervisory action generation. Five action-validation configurations are investigated, comprising operation without validation, an LLM-based judge, digital-twin simulation, and deterministic admissibility checks with and without consequence projection. The framework is evaluated using four LLMs across 20 scenarios involving single and multiple simultaneous faults. Without agent intervention, 18 scenarios result in plant stops, corresponding to an economic loss of $399,000 relative to fault-free operation under the assumed benchmark economics. For GPT-5 nano, Qwen3 8B, and Mistral 7B, validated agent configurations reduce the number of stops to 5-8 and recover $265,000 of the loss. The study provides a reproducible benchmark for comparing agent architectures, language models, and action-validation methods for supervisory fault management in chemical processes.
paragraphs.zh: 开源化工过程故障管理智能体框架，验证配置显著减少工厂停车并挽回经济损失。OperAItor，一个用于开发和评估面向化工过程监督级故障管理的大语言模型智能体的开源框架。 该框架在一个代表异丙醇脱氢的动态反应器-精馏过程上进行了演示，采用基于物理的热力学和经修正的反应动力学以允许液相操作。 该过程由一个113变量的微分代数模型表示，在100kmol/h的名义进料速率下运行，生产约4t/h的丙酮。 模拟工厂包括8个PI控制回路、22个过程报警、5组一用一备泵组以及11个独立的安全仪表功能。 该智能体架构集成了多变量统计过程监测、故障诊断、知识图谱检索、动作规划以及监督级动作生成。 研究考察了五种动作验证配置，包括无验证运行、基于大语言模型的评判器、数字孪生仿真，以及带后果投射和不带后果投射的确定性可接受性检查。 该框架使用四个大语言模型在涉及单一故障和多重并发故障的20个场景中进行了评估。 在无智能体干预的情况下，18个场景导致工厂停车，按假设的基准经济条件计算，相对于无故障运行造成399,000美元的经济损失。 对于GPT-5 nano、Qwen3 8B和Mistral 7B，经验证的智能体配置将停车次数降至5-8次，并挽回了265,000美元的损失。 本研究提供了一个可复现的基准，用于比较面向化工过程监督级故障管理的智能体架构、大语言模型和动作验证方法。
